title: B1 Check resolved bare python to the global interpreter
symptom: Both R01 attempts failed their independent Check with ModuleNotFoundError for yaml even though the B1 environment contained PyYAML
reproduction: Run the Profile R r01_contract whose declared argv begins with the bare name python on Windows

evidence.detail: R3 recorded two check_failed attempts whose stderr was ModuleNotFoundError: No module named yaml

root_cause: On Windows the bare executable search used the parent process search path before the sanitized child PATH, so python resolved to the global interpreter rather than the running B1 virtual environment

considered_options.option: install PyYAML into the global interpreter
considered_options.reason: hides interpreter drift and makes the Check host-dependent

considered_options.option: bind bare python and git names to resolved absolute executables before spawn
considered_options.reason: makes the executable identity deterministic across hosts

resolution: Resolve bare python to sys.executable and bare git to its discovered absolute path while preserving the original declared argv in Check evidence
verification: B1 verification target: 7 passed; B1 full regression: 74 passed
The unchanged R3 workspace R01 Check passed with R01_PUBLIC_CONTRACT_OK and no model turn
remaining_risks: R3 remains a preserved failed measurement; a fresh R4 model run requires separate approval
